label_source: Final user correction 2026-10-29: image 1 LOW performance, image 2 HIGH performance.
scale_note: 100 um red bar spans 50 pixel cells: nominal 2 um/pixel, not optical resolution.
relation_to_overview: Linked by A performance class; exact blade serial and sampled edge location were not supplied.
extraction_status: Local equivalent-circle image estimates available; single-circle representation rejected for image 2. Physical contact radius remains unqualified.
notes: Do not rank actual contact curvature by visual envelope or performance label. Feature windows follow visible geometry, not force data. Near-tip features may be projection or edge irregularity, not identified burrs.

radius_method.sampling: Both raw marching-square vertices and uniform 0.5 pixel arclength; interpolated samples are not independent optical measurements.
radius_method.fit: Orthogonal-distance local circle, NumPy damped Gauss-Newton, multiple starts. Center must lie behind leftmost point; radius 0.1 to 200 pixels. Boundary hits are reported.
radius_method.qualification: Sensitivity ranges do not include optical blur, out-of-plane projection, edge-location variability or instrument calibration. Not statistical confidence intervals.
